# MDN Web Docs

> > MDN Web Docs is Mozilla's comprehensive, open-source documentation platform for web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Web APIs.

Maintained by Mozilla with community contributions, MDN serves as the trusted reference for web developers worldwide. The site includes interactive tools like Playground, security testing via HTTP Observatory, and the annual Web DNA Report on developer needs and browser compatibility.

## Key Topics

- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- Web APIs
- Firefox DevTools
- HTTP Observatory
- Browser compatibility
- Web standards
- Open-source documentation
- Developer community
- Interactive coding (Playground)
- Security best practices
- Responsive design
- Accessibility
- Modern web development

## Learning Resources

- [Getting started modules - Learn web development | MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Getting_started): Beginner modules for installing tools and building first websites
- [Core learning modules - Learn web development | MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Core): Essential web dev curriculum covering modern best practices
- [Web development tutorials - MDN Web Docs | MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/MDN/Tutorials): Tutorials for beginner to expert web developers
- [Web developer guides - MDN Web Docs | MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/MDN/Guides): Curated list of goal-oriented guides for web features and APIs
- [How to solve common problems - Learn web development | MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Howto): Solutions to common front-end problems and CSS troubleshooting

## Interactive Tools

- [Playground | MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/play): Interactive HTML/CSS/JavaScript code editor with sharing features
- [HTTP Header Security Test - HTTP Observatory | MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/observatory): Mozilla's HTTP Observatory tool for security header analysis

## Developer Tools Reference

- [about:debugging — Firefox Source Docs  documentation](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Tools/about:debugging): Firefox DevTools remote debugging setup for Android and extensions

## Community & Insights

- [Contribute to MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/community): Join MDN's global community of contributors and volunteers
- [Web DNA Report | MDN Web Docs](https://insights.developer.mozilla.org): Annual Web DNA reports on developer pain points and browser compat

## About MDN

- [MDN Web Docs](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US): Homepage for MDN Web Docs - trusted resource for web developers
- [About MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/about): About MDN Web Docs, Mozilla's open-source web dev resource & team
